text:
Maya: Morning — spotted a small but consistent billing delta for client-zenith, +1.7% on preview. Anyone else see route attribution noise?
Rahul: Yeah saw default-route jump in the hourly preview around 09:12 UTC.
Maya: I sampled raw billing events and found ~4.2k with route_id explicitly set to null between 09:10-09:25.
Jon: That matches my edge change (trim-empty-headers) that went canary at 09:09 (PR #1410).
DeployBot: deploy-bot: edge-proxy v2.5.0 deployed (canary 5%) @ 2026-03-21T09:09.
Ellie: Can you paste a sanitized sample?
Maya: Sample (sanitized):
```
{ "event_id": "evt_zz01", "tenant": "client-zenith", "session": "s-9abc", "tokens": 42, "route_id": null }
```
Sam: Metering consumer treats explicit null as present -> validation fails -> fallback to default-route SKU. Previously absence meant session-lookup.
Rahul: Short-term mitigations: 1) treat null/empty as missing in metering consumer and attempt session join, 2) pause canary and roll back if needed.
Jon: Rolling back canary now.
DeployBot: deploy-bot: rollback edge-proxy v2.5.0 -> v2.4.9 initiated @ 09:18.
Ops-Bot: ops-bot: incident 2026-03-21-176360 created; channel #inc-176360.
Ellie: Console asks: add metering.routeless_rate metric and alert if >0.4% over 10m; and a small invoice-preview toast when rollout changes preview by >0.5%. Filing ticket.
Maya: I'll run a replay job to join session map and publish corrected events to billing-repair, then run a dry-run invoice. Will post counts in ~20m.
Jon: Postmortem items: revert header trimming default, add e2e header-preservation contract test, and add a small defensive rule in metering consumer for 72h.
Rahul: SQL to find candidates: SELECT event_id FROM billing.events WHERE route_id IS NULL AND session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM sessions.route_map WHERE ts > NOW() - INTERVAL '3 HOURS');
Maya: Good. I'll share numbers once replay finishes. Thanks all.
